messages:
tess (Support): Hey team, AcmeRetail reporting repeated 429s specifically on the /v1/rerank endpoint since ~08:15 UTC. They say traffic is normal for them, but rerank traffic is failing while other endpoints are OK. They sent a sample response.

sam (Customer: AcmeRetail): yeah, started getting flaky around 08:10. We see 429s in our logs, e.g. 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"rate_limited\",
  \"message\": \"rerank quota exceeded\",
  \"retry_after\": 27,
  \"quota_type\": \"rerank_per_minute\"
}
```
Please advise, this is impacting our search relevance pipeline.

ops-bot: Incident created: CS-4321. Paging alex.

alex (SRE): @tess thanks — can you paste a curl (sanitized) and the X-RateLimit* headers from the response? Also need customer request pattern (batch sizes, concurrency).

tess (Support): Copied from customer: their rerank integration uses batching of 50 candidates per request, they send ~150 requests/sec during peak (bursting). Sample request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\n    \"model\": \"rerank-a1\",\n    \"inputs\": [ { \"query\": \"red shoes\", \"candidates\": [ ... 50 items ... ] } ],\n    \"top_k\": 5\n  }'
```
They also attached full response headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 600`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Reset: 1715000400`.

ingrid (Prod Eng): Interesting — the rerank plane has a per-minute quota for non-dedicated customers that is stricter than standard generate endpoints. Looks like they hit the minute bucket. Two notes: 1) our rate limit windows are minute-aligned which causes burst collisions when many clients send batched rerank simultaneously, 2) batching 50 candidates multiplies cost per request; rerank is billed/limited per candidate or per request? IIRC per-request weight != linear but we do count as weight= len(candidates) for quota.

sam (Customer: AcmeRetail): we thought quota was per-request. Oops. Any quick mitigation?

tess (Support): I told them to reduce batch size to 10 and add jitter/backoff, but want engineering to confirm if we can temporarily raise their quota while they rework integration.

alex (SRE): I pulled metrics — traffic spike from acct_acmeretail ID=acct-7799 at 08:09 to 08:18: 8.2k candidate evaluations/minute, sustained. Rerank service applied global per-minute limiter: limit=6000 candidates/min for their tier, so they exceeded. Also saw many simultaneous short bursts causing Remaining to drop to 0 and Retry-After ~20s returned.

ingrid (Prod Eng): @alex can you paste the exact rate-limit response payload we return? I want consistent repro.

alex (SRE): payload is like: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"rate_limited\",
  \"type\": \"quota_exceeded\",
  \"quota\": \"rerank_per_minute\",
  \"limit\": 6000,
  \"used\": 6052,
  \"retry_after\": 22
}
```
Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit: 6000`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `Retry-After: 22`

re-ranker-bot: Detected 12 bucket overflows for acct-7799 in the last 10m; moving to escalations queue.

tess (Support): Customer asked for repro steps so they can test their fixes. Can we provide a small script to reproduce 429 with similar pattern?

ingrid (Prod Eng): Sure — dev repro (non-prod) uses the following pattern to hit per-minute bucket quickly: 
```
# stress-repro.sh (example)
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer STAGING_KEY\" \
    -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
    -d '{\"model\":\"rerank-a1\",\"inputs\":[{\"query\":\"x\",\"candidates\":[\'"$(yes 'cand' | head -n 50 | sed -z 's/\\n/,/g; s/,$//')"\']}]}' &
done
wait
```
Run that for a few seconds against stage to reproduce instant 429s.

sam (Customer: AcmeRetail): Thanks, we'll try that in staging.

alex (SRE): Temporary remediation options: 
- Increase their per-minute quota to 20k candidates/min for next 24h (manual override)
- Advise reducing batch size and adding random jitter and exponential backoff
- Offer Dedicated capacity (isolated quota) if they need stable throughput
I can do the 24h bump if support approves.

tess (Support): Please do the 24h bump, customer is in production and will deploy fixes in next 12h. Also open a billing note for potential overage.

alex (SRE): Done — increased rerank_per_minute limit for acct-7799 to 20000 until 2026-03-16T08:15Z. Logged change ID RL-9981. Notified customer.

ingrid (Prod Eng): Longer term action items: 
- Add candidate-weighted rate-limit headers so clients can programmatically know cost per request (UX change)
- Smooth per-minute buckets with sliding window rate limiter to avoid synchronized bursts
- Add automatic guidance for batching (suggested max candidates per request by tier) in docs
- Track and alert on candidate-rate per account, not just request count
Assigning to eng-backlog: ENG-2217.

tess (Support): Customer confirmed service is back to normal after bump and minor code changes. They still want docs update + API hinting.

sam (Customer: AcmeRetail): Confirmed — thanks for the quick help. We'll dial down concurrency and test in staging. Appreciate the quota bump. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: CS-4321 marked RESOLVED by tess.

alex (SRE): Leaving follow-up: watch acct-7799 metrics for 48h for reoccurrence. If it spikes again, we'll consider recommending Dedicated or programmatic quota negotiation.

ingrid (Prod Eng): Also flag for product: rerank-specific quota model is confusing to users; propose clearer naming (\"candidate-min\" vs \"requests-min\").

tess (Support): Closing thread, will add a KB article with repro steps + recommended client changes (batch size, backoff, header parsing) and link to ENG-2217.

sam (Customer: AcmeRetail): thanks everyone!
